scenarios.name: no_harvest
scenarios.description: Baseline: no rows harvested, all readers at ideal 1-hop positions

scenarios.name: single_harvest
scenarios.description: One odd row harvested, displacing one right-side reader

scenarios.name: double_harvest
scenarios.description: One even + one odd row harvested, displacing one reader per side

scenarios.name: triple_harvest
scenarios.description: Three even rows harvested, displacing three left-side readers into adjacent odd rows

scenarios.name: adjacent_harvest
scenarios.description: Two adjacent rows (even+odd) harvested, forcing multi-hop displacement on both sides

scenarios.name: heavy_harvest
scenarios.description: Five rows harvested including a block of four adjacent rows. Right-side banks 7 and 8 are forced onto the single remaining row y=1, competing with bank 6 for column positions. Left-side banks must navigate column-spreading to avoid south-segment link conflicts.
